    Using this on your Android phone

    Open this page in Chrome. Tap Take a photo to use your camera, or choose a saved image. After preparing offline use, Chrome’s menu → Add to Home screen may offer installation. Offline availability depends on your browser keeping the downloaded files; sign-in may be needed when reopening the hosted link online.

    Images and extracted text are kept in tab memory only. Closing or reloading the page clears them. Copying or saving text creates a separate copy on your device. Your camera app may retain photos. Only scanner code and OCR language files are cached.
